name: Waste
overview: Scripture teaches that God has entrusted humanity with the responsible stewardship of His creation, commanding us to be fruitful and exercise dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:28). This stewardship includes caring for the vulnerable by intentionally leaving portions of the harvest for the poor and strangers, demonstrating God's covenant faithfulness and blessing to those who obey His commands (Leviticus 23:22; Deuteronomy 24:19; Deuteronomy 7:9). The sacredness of the land is emphasized, warning against pollution and the defilement caused by bloodshed, underscoring the need to honor God's provision and maintain purity in our use of resources (Numbers 35:33). Wisdom calls us to embrace God's law fully, avoiding wastefulness and embracing good doctrine for a life that honors Him (Proverbs 4:2).
